description: Multi-finding aggregation benchmark for SecuraX risk engine evaluation. Each scenario contains 3-12 correlated vulnerability findings. Ground truth is scenario-level (not per-finding). Pre-registration: docs/research/E2_HYPOTHESIS.md
ground_truth_policy: Ground truth was assigned BEFORE running any engine against scenarios. Ground truth does not change when the engine changes.

scenario_types.accumulation: Multiple medium findings collectively elevating risk tier
scenario_types.kev_amplified: Known-exploit finding combined with internet exposure
scenario_types.isolated_critical: Single overwhelming critical among low-severity noise

provenance: Synthetic scenarios constructed from documented CVE exploitation patterns and MITRE ATT&CK technique combinations. Not from live scans.
